<view class="space-y-4">
  <view class="text-xl font-bold">Table w/ plus-minus</view>
  <accordion type="single" collapsible class="w-full -space-y-px" bind:change="handleValueChange" value="{{value}}">
    <block wx:for="{{items}}" wx:key="id" wx:for-index="itemIndex" wx:for-item="item">
      <accordion-item value="{{item.id}}" class="bg-background has-focus-visible:border-ring has-focus-visible:ring-ring/50 relative border px-4 py-1 outline-none first:rounded-t-md last:rounded-b-md last:border-b has-focus-visible:z-10 has-focus-visible:ring-[3px]">
        <view slot="trigger" class="flex flex-1 items-center justify-between rounded-md py-2 text-left text-sm text-[15px] leading-6 font-semibold transition-all outline-none focus-visible:ring-0 [&>svg>path:last-child]:origin-center [&>svg>path:last-child]:transition-all [&>svg>path:last-child]:duration-200 [&[data-state=open]>svg]:rotate-180 [&[data-state=open]>svg>path:last-child]:rotate-90 [&[data-state=open]>svg>path:last-child]:opacity-0">
          {{item.title}}
        </view>
        <view slot="icon" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 opacity-60 transition-transform duration-200">
          <text class="text-sm font-semibold">+</text>
        </view>
<view slot="content" class="text-muted-foreground pb-2">{{item.content}}</view>
      </accordion-item>
    </block>
  </accordion>
</view>

Timkit UI focuses on developer experience and performance. Built with TypeScript, it offers excellent type safety, follows accessibility standards, and provides comprehensive documentation with regular updates.
Use our CSS variables for global styling, or className and style props for component-specific changes. We support CSS modules, Tailwind, and dark mode out of the box.

All components follow WAI-ARIA standards, featuring proper ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support. Regular testing ensures compatibility with NVDA, VoiceOver, and JAWS.
